headline: Tanzania Invites Investors to Gold Refining, Nickel and Copper Processing, Heavy Mineral Sands and Niobium as Mining Conference 2026 Opens
summary: Tanzania's government opened its 2026 mining conference by inviting investors into gold refining, nickel and copper processing, heavy mineral sands and ferro-niobium plants. A nickel project agreement is due to be signed soon.
why: Tanzania is an established gold producer, and downstream processing investment determines how much value stays in the country and how mining projects develop.
